title: How Ramp's Eric Glyman Built a $22.5 Billion Startup in 2,367 Days | Titans and Disruptors
description:
Description: Ramp CEO Eric Glyman has helped build one of fintech’s fastest-growing startups — hitting $1 billion in annualized revenue, serving 45,000 businesses, and soaring to a $22.5 billion valuation in just 2,367 days. In this episode of Fortune 500: Titans and Disruptors of Industry, he sits down with Fortune’s Editor-in-Chief Alyson Shontell to break down Ramp’s meteoric rise, the business model flipping corporate cards on their head, and why he believes speed and focus are the keys to scaling.

00:00 Introduction: Inside Ramp’s Rocket Fueled Growth
1:25 Behind Ramp’s $22.6 Billion Valuation
2:45: Ramp’s Money-Saving Business Strategy
4:15: Ramp’s Hyper-Scale Strategy and Urgency Culture
6:21: Flipping the Corporate Card Incentive System
7:57: Ramp’s Competitors
10:26: Leveraging AI for Growth
12:34: How AI Efficiencies Save Clients Money
17:22: Eric Glyman’s Perspective on AI Taking Jobs
20:19: Ramp’s Market Standing and Future Growth
23:35: What it’s like being the “hot” new startup
25:33: Glyman’s Leadership Mindset
